title: Adjective + preposition 2
subtitle: afraid of, good at, interested in, similar to, married to…

theory.text: Продолжаем прилагательные с предлогами. Больше всего сочетаний с of, но есть и с at, to, from, in, on, with, for.

head: Предлог
Прилагательные
Пример
rows: afraid, scared, frightened, terrified; fond, proud, ashamed, jealous, envious; suspicious, critical, tolerant; aware, conscious; capable, incapable; typical; full, short

items: typical OF him — «это на него похоже»: It's typical of him to forget.

theory.text: She is married to Tom — она замужем за Томом. She is married with two kids — она замужем, и у неё двое детей.
Русское «хорош в чём-то» подталкивает к good in — правильно good at. «Женат на» — married to, а не married on/with. «Интересуюсь» — interested in, без by.

en: My sister is afraid of dogs.
My sister is scared of dogs.
My sister is frightened of dogs.
Are you good at chess?
Are you good at playing chess?
I'm hopeless at cooking.
I'm completely hopeless at cooking.
Your parents are proud of you.
I'm ashamed of my behaviour.
I'm ashamed of my behavior.
Why are you jealous of your brother?
Why are you envious of your brother?

items.ru: Охранник отнёсся к нам с подозрением.
en: The guard was suspicious of us.

items.ru: Я не знал об этой проблеме.
en: I wasn't aware of this problem.
I wasn't aware of the problem.
He is capable of more.
He is capable of doing more.

items.ru: Она опять опоздала, это так на неё похоже.
en: She's late again, that's so typical of her.
She's late again, it's so typical of her.
She was late again, that's so typical of her.
Your bag is similar to mine.

items.ru: Алекс всё ещё зависит от родителей.
en: Alex is still dependent on his parents.

items.ru: Она хочет быть независимой от семьи.
en: She wants to be independent of her family.
Are you interested in history?
Italy is famous for its food.
Are you sure about the time?
Are you sure of the time?
Are you certain about the time?
Are you certain of the time?

items.ru: Новый офис сильно отличается от старого.
en: The new office is very different from the old one.
The new office is very different to the old one.
The new office is very different from the old office.
The museum was full of schoolchildren.
The museum was crowded with schoolchildren.
The museum was full of school children.
The streets were crowded with cars.
The streets were full of cars.
Nick isn't very keen on football.
Nick isn't very fond of football.
Who is responsible for this room?
I'm a bit short of time now.
I'm short of time now.
I'm short of time at the moment.
Helen is married to an Italian.
Helen is married to an Italian man.

items.ru: Дэн женат, и у него трое детей.
en: Dan is married with three children.
Dan is married with three kids.
